label: ssec:descent-prelim-intro
html: We describe how structure restricts from A_{n+1} to A_n in the brane tower. We show the restriction map r_n \colon A_n \to A_{n-1} induces a surjective algebra homomorphism \mathfrak{d}_n on the endomorphism algebras. This map intertwines the G_q-actions. Each descending level inherits the complete quantum observable universe (QOU) structure. We compose ascent and descent to form the idempotent descent involution \hat{\tau}_n = \ell_n \circ \mathfrak{d}_{n+1}. Its image isolates the descended subalgebra within \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A_{n+1}). We compute both mechanisms in the \mathrm{SU}(2) archimedean model. The lifting obstruction calculus requires both the descent involution and the surjectivity of \mathfrak{d}_n.
